description: Audit a Japanese payslip: recompute statutory premiums and withholding tax from official tables and diff against the actual amounts, with per-item verdicts (match/explainable/mismatch). $0.02/call. Deterministic, cites primary sources; errors and unverified rules are never billed.

age.description: Age in years (selects care-insurance and other age-gated rules)

as_of.description: Calculation reference date YYYY-MM-DD (default today); selects the rules version

payslip.description: Payslip fields to audit - see /catalog input spec

standard_monthly_yen.description: Standard monthly remuneration if known (else estimated from salary)

x_payment.description: Optional: base64 X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet). Omit it to receive the payment requirements (accepts[] + docs) for this call without being charged.

name: jp_payslip_audit

body.description: JSON body of the underlying call (see /samples/{product} for each product's shape)

payment_required.description: true when status is 402: body holds x402 payment terms, not a result. Pay and call again with x_payment

receipt_id.description: set on paid results; free re-fetch via get_receipt

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying call (200 result, 402 payment terms, 4xx input error)

title: Jp Payslip Audit
